[spoiler=Wellassona officially joins the International Cricket Council] 
[i]Wellassonan National News - Новеллсти Нациоьнлыы Веласоньый. Friday, 22 October 2027[/i]

Last week, Wellassona was officially admitted into the Erene International Cricket Council.

The Council, founded earlier in the month, is the international governing body of cricket. Other countries had already joined the organization upon its founding, with Wellassona being the 12th and most recent member to join, as well as the only country from Elseyr in the organisation thus far.

Cricket had never been particularly popular in Wellassona. The sport first arrived in Wellassona in 1934, around a decade after the establishment of the Wellassonan People's Republic. It became popular within the Communist party, and soon became a favourite sport among the communist leaders. By the 1970's, cricket had began to gain popularity among the general public as well, but it could never compete with the popularity of other sports, such as (association) football, basketball, and ice hockey. Today, cricket is only modestly popular among Wellassonans, but is quickly gaining popularity. The Vendsyat Velasona (literally "Wellassona Twenty"), Wellassona's official Twenty20 cricket league, was founded in 2018, and is rapidly gaining prominence in the country.

In a press conference earlier this week, PM Danil Sokolova stated that the move was to [i]"Increase Wellassona's prominence on the global scale",[/i] and that [i]"Wellassona has been out of the world's view for far too long"[/i]. PM Sokolova has made numerous efforts to increase Wellassona's cultural influence, particularly through sport. Delyava Ünveutguli, the Welfare and Culture minister, also supported the choice to join the ICC. She stated, [i]"The choice was clear: the opportunity to connect with the world through cricket was one that could not be missed. We are excited for the upcoming tournaments, and for the development of cricket in the country"[/i] 

There has been some skepticism about the decision to join the ICC. Ipatiy Sergeev, had of the Toward the Future party and Leader of the Opposition, called the move [i]"unusual"[/i], noting that [i]"Wellassona doesn't have a strong cricket culture"[/i] and that joing the ICC was [i] "Some kind of PR stunt" [/i]. However, he still expressed interest, stating, [i] "I nevertheless look forward to Wellassona's participation in the cricket competitions, and for the prospects it might bring"[/i].

Wellassona is set to field a Men's and a Women's teams, which are governed by the National Cricket Association of Wellassona (AKNV), at the upcoming international Cricket tournaments.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]Hochbayern-Eisenmark[/b]]

The first known inhabitants of Eisenmark-Hochbayern were the celtic peoples who migrated south during the first century and displaced other local nomadic proto-Hochdeutsche groups in the area. A century later the Panesan Republic in its later stages would seize control of the territory and declare it a province of the Republic and later the Empire. Frequent raids by the celtic peoples and combat saw the creation of fortified zones or limes that utilized Panesan forts and walls some of which can be seen to this day. During this time due to its extreme distance from the Panesan heartland in southern Elseyr the area had limited Panesan settlement and the population would remain majority celtic. During the later weakening of the Panesan Republic the province would slowly be tossed aside in imperial politics and later would cause a full withdrawal of Panesan forces from the area. With the migration of proto-Hochdeutsche peoples into the area, the Ferri would establish a Kingdom in the north of the modern day Republik which incorporated parts of the state of Eisenmark-Hochbayern. 

With the formation of the First Hochdeutsche Empire or Holy Imperial Confederation in 438, the Duchy of Hochbayern would become one of the five major states of the Confederation. At the same time the holder of the title of Duke of Hochbayern would also become an elector of the Confederation. The ducal house Valriche would hold power in Hochbayern for the majority of the time of the Confederation with a brief interruption between 1078 and 1109. The Duchy of Hochbayern and its satellite enclaves in the divided states of Eisenmark would play a key role in imperial politics. During the religious wars of the 1300s the Duchy would be a leader of the Nordlicht League, a protestant alliance against the southern states of the Confederation and would become wealthy through its control over the strait of the north. In 1345 the Duke of Hochbayern would notably negotiate the Treaty of Ostphalia with the Emperor of the Confederation which would help end decades of civil war and religious conflict. As the wealth of Hochbayern increased, so did its acquisition of territory in Eisenmark. The divided petty fiefs of the area would continually sell off land or endure military action from Hochbayern until much of the northern half of the petty states had been annexed under the authority of the House Valriche. 

During the Battle of Büdingen, the Emperor would raise the patriarchs of House Valriche to the title of Grand Duke granting them authority over much of the rest of Eisenmark in thanks for their support against the Catholic states of the south. Under the peace of Ostphalia the Duchy became a decidedly protestant one with a line of protestant rulers under House Valriche enforcing their right to establish the official religion of their territories. Although this policy was unpopular with their subjects in the south of Eisenmark many would remain within the borders of the Duchy due to long-held property and connections. In 1799 House Valriche would be removed from power after the dissolution of the Holy Imperial Confederation and the period of reforms led by the Second Hochdeutsche Empire. The expansion of the absolutist state co-opted the Catholic nobles of the south and began marginalizing the northern constituents of the former confederation. While further Eisenmark states would be pulled into Hochbayern-Eisenmark during this time the old Duchy would be reformed into a margravate which would be held by members of the ruling imperial family through inheritance. 

The modern economic system of Hochbayern-Eisenmark would begin to take hold in the 1800s as the nation pushed forward with its Miracle on the Aethel or Aethel Capitalism. With a heavy focus on state-directed industrialization, Hochbayern-Eisenmark would be a key piece in the late Second Empire's plans to make the nation an industrial and export powerhouse. While heavy steel manufacturing would be handled in the south in the Stahlwerke region of the nation, heavy equipment would be produced in Hochbayern. Textile machinery used to convert the wool of the Empire to exportable textiles as well as steel machinery would be major exports of Hochbayern. While initially Hochbayern would play a supporting role in an increasingly export focused economy it would later break into the global economy in its own right through its pioneering of chemical synthesis. Synthetic dies would be heavily produced in the region during the 1800s and exported across the nation as well as globally. Pharmaceutical companies would also take off in Eisenmark as the invention and production of blood thinners and other medicines would be produced. 

Under the Third Hochdeutsche Empire and its liberal economic reforms the automobile industry of the nation would begin to develop in Hochbayern-Eisenmark. High speed petrol engines would begin to power self-propelling carriages in the 1870s under Gottlieb Braun who would later found Bayerische Kraft-Maschinen or ultimate precision machines. Following in the steps of the United States but with a greater emphasis on performance and luxury vehicles the Hochdeutsche manufacturers such as BKM and Gottlieb Auto would begin to build assembly lines primarily within Hochbayern-Eisenmark. The BKM 3/20 would become commonplace on the streets of the Empire with widespread sales and civilian use of BKM cars. The auto companies would begin to support various imperial war efforts including in Panesa including in the manufacturing of the Panzerkampfwagen 4, 3 and various light tanks. Pioneering straight six engines in 1923, BKM would continue to produce performance cars while employing thousands at its plants in the north of the Empire. Mass market brands such as Gottlieb would dominate within domestic markets with widespread usage and the creation of massive plants along the river Aethel to produce their automobiles in the millions. While the rest of the country has pushed into services and technology including in the booming financial metropolis of Neudresden the manufacturing center of Hochbayern-Eisenmark has seen modest growth. A heavy focus on automation, state support and continued brand prestige has supported manufacturers in the Republik although foreign competition through globalization has been fierce. Economically the region of Hochbayern-Eisenmark is slightly higher than the average median income with large contributions to the national budget and economy. 

[/spoiler]

[spoiler= OPBS Nightly Report 22 October 2026] 

[i] Welcome to Haliyansk, Ostarevs frontier city. This historic city bears the scars of many conflicts throughout its history, but today a new war is unfolding. This war is silent. It is not fought in the open, nor with tanks, planes, or warships. Instead, it is fought by small groups of men and women, in alleyways, forests, and stash houses.

Haliyansk now sits on the front lines of Ostarevs newest conflict: the silent war against illegal smuggling across its many land borders.

We are in Haliyansk tonight to speak with the Provincial Police Chief and to examine some of the items his officers have uncovered over the past few months. Authorities tell us there has been a sharp increase in the volume of smuggled goods entering the nation. The types of contraband entering Ostarev are wide-ranging. Predictably, narcotics remain the most common, followed closely by firearms and military equipment, sanctioned or restricted goods, and even human trafficking. Police and border officers are not only tasked with stopping illicit items from entering the nation, they must also prevent valuable resources from leaving it.

Ostarevi gold, for example, has become a major target for smuggling networks. While gold exports would not normally raise alarms, recent investigations have revealed that criminal organizations are moving gold across multiple countries to conceal its origins and remove it from official records. This gold is then used to finance terrorist organizations, underground movements, and other destabilizing actors. Investigators have also confirmed that terrorist groups are actively smuggling both personnel and weapons across national borders.

Smuggling has become such a significant issue in the region that, in 2024, the Government of Kazhevikstan created the Kazhevik Border Force, a paramilitary organization designed to supplement police and military units patrolling its borders. Within Ostarev, calls are growing for a similar force to be established. We asked Provincial Police Chief Pytor Leonid for his opinion. When we met him earlier today, he told us the following:

Over the past year, my officers have arrested more than one hundred smugglers attempting to bring illicit items across our borders. We have seized over 7,000 pounds of narcotics, 2,500 firearms, 58 individuals being trafficked, and nearly 2,000 pounds of gold. My officers patrol one of the smallest provinces in the nation, yet we oversee the longest stretch of international border. I have only 150 officers at my disposal, and it is my professional opinion that continuing to patrol the border while fulfilling our other duties is becoming untenable. I call upon the President to establish a dedicated Border Security Force. ~ Provincial Police Chief Pytor Leonid

The police chiefs concerns are echoed by many Ostarevi citizens whose lives have been directly affected by the recent influx of smuggled goods. In Haliyansk alone, violent crime has risen by 26 percent, while drug usage is estimated to have increased by 75 percent. With higher drug usage has come a corresponding rise in overdose cases.

Authorities stress that this crisis is not limited to Haliyansk. Border communities near Uburistan, Kazhevikstan, and Kyratov are all experiencing similar challenges. Thus far, Kyratov has been the only neighboring state actively cooperating with Ostarev, with both nations forming a joint law enforcement task force to combat cross-border smuggling. According to our sources, the Government of Kazhevikstan has held discussions with Ostarevi officials, but appears more focused on addressing the problem within its own borders than assisting operations inside Ostarev. Meanwhile, the Government of Uburistan has not contacted Ostarev at all.

Citizens across Ostarevs border regions are hoping for a resolution to this silent war, one that has left their communities increasingly unsafe and has contributed to rising tensions throughout the region. Smuggling has now become one of the most pressing security challenges facing the Belorevan nations in recent history.

From Haliyansk, this is Constantine Reznov, reporting for the Ostarevi Public Broadcasting Service.[/i]

[/spoiler]
